blurb: VGolf offers a 15,000 sq ft indoor facility with 20 advanced golf simulators and multisport screens. Guests can play virtual golf on over 2000 prestigious courses year-round or enjoy other interactive sports games. The center also hosts tournaments, leagues, and provides golf lessons with PGA Canada certified pros.
